task-iteration-assignments.title: Move tasks to an iteration
task-iteration-assignments.intro: Review the selected tasks and confirm the move.
task-iteration-assignments.scope: This updates the iteration assignment for each selected task.
task-iteration-assignments.no_changes: The selected tasks are already in this destination.
task-iteration-assignments.incomplete: The current schedule could not be verified for all selected tasks.
task-iteration-assignments.completed_sou: Reopen the completed iteration in Planning before moving its tasks.
task-iteration-assignments.source_unavai: A task's current iteration could not be verified. Refresh the task list and try again.
task-iteration-assignments.version_exhau: One selected task's schedule has reached its version limit.
task-iteration-assignments.stale: The selection or schedule has changed. Review the current tasks before confirming.
task-iteration-assignments.recovery_help: Check the original operation before starting another move.
task-iteration-assignments.storage_help: Local recovery storage is unavailable. Restore storage access and reopen the page.
task-iteration-assignments.refresh_faile: The move is confirmed. Refresh the task list to see the current schedule.
task-iteration-assignments.access_change: Project access has changed. Recheck access to continue.
task-iteration-assignments.access_invali: Could not verify current project access. The original operation remains available.
